answer: The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, capped per identity per epoch, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Every claim climbs the vault of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the bridge re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. By the ridge of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
